subject: chemistry

questions.question: How is ethane prepared from ethene? Write the reaction mechanism.
questions.solution:
**Addition of H₂ across the double bond (hydrogenation):**
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂ → CH₃-CH₃

Conditions: Ni/Pt catalyst, heat (~200°C)

**Mechanism (catalytic hydrogenation):**
1. H₂ adsorbs on metal surface
2. C=C π-bond breaks and C-H bonds form
3. Ethane desorbs from catalyst surface
questions.knowledgeNote: Alkenes undergo addition reactions; alkanes undergo substitution (free radical).
